items.title: Sinners
items.age_restriction: 16 D H L P S V
items.overview: Sinners is a 2025 horror film written and directed by Ryan Coogler. Set in 1932 in the Mississippi Delta, it stars Michael B. Jordan in dual roles as twin brothers who return to their hometown, hoping to leave their troubled lives behind, only to discover an even greater evil waiting for them. The film co-stars Hailee Steinfeld, Miles Caton, Jack O’Connell and Wunmi Mosaku.

items.title: Grease
items.overview: Grease is a classic musical rom-com that unfolds the 1958 summer romance of T-Bird greaser – Danny and good girl – Australian transfer student Sandy. The film stars John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John as Danny and Sandy.

items.title: It’s Complicated
items.overview: It’s Complicated is a 2009 American romantic comedy film. It stars Meryl Streep as a bakery owner and single mother of three who starts a secret affair with her ex-husband, played by Alec Baldwin, ten years after their divorce – only to find herself drawn to another manh her architect, Adam (portrayed by Steve Martin).

items.title: Pirates Of The Caribbean Dead Man’s Chest
items.detail_title: Pirates Of The Caribbean Dead Man’s Chest
items.overview: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest is a 2006 fantasy action-adventure film and the second instalment in the Pirates of the Caribbean series. Captain Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) owes a debt to Davy Jones and is pursued by the fearsome Kraken, while Will Turner (Orlando Bloom) and Elizabeth Swann (Keira Knightley) are drawn into the hunt for the legendary Dead Man’s Chest.

items.title: Star Wars: Empire Strikes Back
items.overview: The Empire Strikes Back is a 1980 epic space fantasy and the second instalment of the original Star Wars trilogy. Luke Skywalker begins his Jedi training while Darth Vader relentlessly hunts the heroes, leading to a dramatic confrontation that changes everything. ⭐ May the Force be with you! Watch this legendary classic under the stars.

items.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
items.detail_title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
items.overview: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again is a 2018 British-American jukebox musical romantic comedy and a feel-good Galileo favourite, featuring the iconic music of ABBA. Serving as both a prequel and sequel to the 2008 hit Mamma Mia! , the film stars an ensemble cast including Amanda Seyfried, Pierce Brosnan, Colin Firth, Meryl Streep and Cher. Set after the events of the first film, the story is interwoven with flashbacks to Donna’s youth in 1979, connecting the two timelines.

items.title: Thelma and Louise – Royale
items.overview: Thelma & Louise is a 1991 American buddy comedy drama film written by Callie Khouri and directed by Ridley Scott. The film stars Geena Davis and Susan Sarandon as Thelma and Louise, two friends who embark on a road trip that ends up in unforeseen circumstances. The supporting cast includes Harvey Keitel, Michael Madsen, Christopher McDonald and Brad Pitt.

items.title: Call Me By Your Name
items.overview: Call Me by Your Name is a 2017 LGBTQ+ coming-of-age romantic drama directed by Luca Guadagnino. Set in northern Italy in 1983, it follows 17-year-old Elio (Timothée Chalamet) and Oliver (Armie Hammer), a graduate student staying with Elio’s family, as friendship develops into a tender summer romance and an awakening of first love.

items.title: The Proposal
items.overview: The Proposal is a 2009 romantic comedy starring Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds. When a demanding book editor faces deportation to Canada, she convinces her unsuspecting assistant to marry her so she can stay in the U.S. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon becomes hilariously complicated. The film also stars Betty White, Mary Steenburgen and Craig T. Nelson.

items.title: How To Train Your Dragon
items.overview: How to Train Your Dragon is a 2010 animated fantasy adventure set in the mythical Viking village of Berk. Hiccup, a young Viking determined to become a dragon slayer, befriends a rare Night Fury dragon named Toothless and soon discovers that everything his village believes about dragons may be wrong.
